premise.en: Tess Mahoney has a clicking knee, two concussions, and a retirement party booked for the 23rd. Camille Duval still has seasons left in her and a new blocker who reads her hips perfectly. You decide how Tess stops, what she says out loud, and whether a plant market at 8 a.m. can be a date.

en: After everyone leaves, the track is just tape on concrete under half the lights. Tess skates slow laps in street clothes. Camille watches from the bench.
I want a life where my body isn’t holding the whole thing up. Where I don’t have to brace.
I know. It just got hard to remember.
I roll to a stop in front of her. She had four seasons on me when I showed up—a rookie with fresh wheels and no idea how to fall.
Saturday I’m running drills with the new blocker. Come watch. If you’re going to hate how good she is, hate it to my face.
I’m going to hate it. I’m going to go anyway. I’m going to wear my good jacket.

我想过一种不用靠身体撑起一切的生活。不用时时刻刻绷着。
我以为我们会一起停下。
我们本来就不是一起开始的。
我知道。只是后来越来越难记得。
我滑到她面前停下。我入队的时候，她已经打了四个赛季——而我是个轮子崭新、连怎么摔倒都不会的新人。
周六我带新拦截手练战术。来看吧。你要是讨厌她那么好，就当着我的面讨厌。
我会讨厌的。但我还是会去。我还要穿我最好的那件夹克。

en: Saturday scrimmage. The new blocker, Dee, is twenty-six, fearless, and reads Camille’s hips like she’s been doing it for years. Tess sits in the second row.
I break through the pack on Dee’s whip three times running. I look for Tess in the stands every time. I don’t mean to.
I clap. I mean it. I also want to throw my water bottle, gently, at the concept of time.
Water break. Camille skates over, sweaty and grinning and trying not to.
I hate that you’re good together.
I can miss you and still play.
She can. That’s the problem. It’s also the whole reason I love watching her.
zh: 周六对抗赛。新拦截手Dee，二十六岁，天不怕地不怕，读Camille的走位就像读了好多年。Tess坐在看台第二排。
我借着Dee的甩送连续三次冲出人墙。每一次我都往看台上找Tess。不是故意的。
我鼓掌。真心的。同时我也想把水瓶轻轻地砸向“时间”这个概念。
喝水休息。Camille滑过来，一身汗，笑得藏都藏不住。
我可以想你，也可以继续上场。
她可以。问题就在这儿。可这也正是我那么爱看她滑的原因。

en: Three weeks later. Tess’s windowsill holds seven plants and one retired knee pad working as a saucer. Camille comes by after an away bout, still smelling like the rink.
I set down a new pot: the fern from the flyer. Found it at a hardware store in a town we lost in.
We lost by forty. I didn’t care as much as I used to. That scared me a little.
That’s allowed. So is caring. You don’t have to quit because I did.
I’m not quitting. I’ve got two more seasons in me, maybe three. I’d like you in the stands for some of them. Not all.
Some. Not all. It’s the most honest schedule anyone has ever offered me.
zh: 三周后。Tess的窗台上摆着七盆植物，还有一只退役的护膝，被当成了花盆托。Camille打完客场赛过来，身上还带着场馆的味道。
我放下一盆新的：就是传单上那种蕨。在一个我们输了比赛的小镇五金店里找到的。
输了四十分。我没有以前那么在乎了。这让我有点害怕。
这没关系。在乎也没关系。你不用因为我退了就也退。
我不退。我还能打两个赛季，也许三个。我希望其中有些比赛你在看台上。不用每一场。
有些，不用每一场。这是别人给过我的最诚实的日程表。
